name: CE_STMT_LINE_CHARGES_INT
description: CE_STMT_LINE_CHARGES_INT contains information about statement line charges interface.

columns.name: STMT_LINE_CHARGES_INT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of statement line charges.

columns.name: STATEMENT_LINE_INT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the statement line interface.

columns.name: LINE_CHARGES_AMT
columns.description: Transaction charges to be paid by the charge bearer.

columns.name: CHARGE_SERVICE_CODE
columns.description: Service for which a charge is asked or paid.

columns.name: CHARGE_PERCENT_RATE
columns.description: Rate used to calculate the amount of charge or fee.

columns.name: BEARER_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the party or parties that will bear the charges associated with the processing of the payment transaction.

columns.name: TAX_CURR
columns.description: Currency of the tax amount paid.

columns.name: TAX_ID
columns.description: Reference identifying the nature of tax levied.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Rate used to calculate the tax.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
